metadata.title: Which countries will have a recession before 2027?
metadata.subtitle: Before 2027
metadata.earlyCloseCondition: If this event occurs, the market will close the following 10:00 AM ET.

data.closeCondition: If this event occurs, the market will close the following 10:00 AM ET.

markets.title: United Kingdom
markets.rulesPrimary: If United Kingdom has two consecutive quarters of negative real GDP growth between Jan 1, 2024 and Dec 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rulesSecondary: The exact dataset for United Kingdom is GDP, Real, Seasonally Adjusted, Domestic Currency from the IMF.

markets.title: Japan
markets.rulesPrimary: If Japan has two consecutive quarters of negative real GDP growth between Jan 1, 2024 and Dec 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rulesSecondary: The exact dataset for Japan is GDP, real, seasonally adjusted, domestic currency from the IMF.

metadata.title: Texas Senate winner?
metadata.subtitle: In 2026
metadata.earlyCloseCondition: This market will close early following the swearing in of the Senator for the seat in question.

data.closeCondition: This market will close early following the swearing in of the Senator for the seat in question.

markets.title: James Talarico
markets.rulesPrimary: If a representative of the Democratic party is sworn in as a Senator of Texas for the term beginning in 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rulesSecondary: This market is eligible for accelerated determination after a consensus of media organizations project the winner. See full rules for details.
